prospective_status: Frozen from OpenML metadata before downloading feature values, labels, or any Q-PLE/midrank outcomes for these datasets.
control: T+T with exactly two members, the same per-member active parameter budget, model family, seeds, optimizer, epochs, and equal averaging.
selection: Choose T+Q or T+midrank using validation primary loss; use equal 50/50 prediction averaging and no test-dependent adjustment.
split: Deterministic 60/20/20 split, stratified for classification, with split seeds frozen before outcome download.
prospective_test_gate: At least 8/12 primary-metric test wins versus T+T, positive mean relative test gain overall and within both task families, and positive per-dataset mean test gain on at least 3/4 datasets.
